mapper.update: UPDATE CONTRACT_SEMANTIC_PLAN SET CURRENT_ATTEMPT_ID=#{row.currentAttemptId},OWNER=#{row.owner},FENCE=#{row.fence},LEASE_UNTIL=#{row.leaseUntil},STATUS=#{row.status},USED_CALLS=#{row.usedCalls},RESERVED_CALLS=#{row.reservedCalls},USED_REPAIRS=#{row.usedRepairs},RESERVED_REPAIRS=#{row.reservedRepairs},USED_MS=#{row.usedMs},RESERVED_MS=#{row.reservedMs},FINAL_RESULT_SHA256=#{row.finalResultSha256},VERSION_NO=#{row.versionNo},UPDATED_AT=#{row.updatedAt} WHERE PLAN_ID=#{expected.planId} AND RUN_ID=#{expected.runId} AND STEP_ID=#{expected.stepId} AND CURRENT_ATTEMPT_ID=#{expected.currentAttemptId} AND OWNER=#{expected.owner} AND FENCE=#{expected.fence} AND STATUS=#{expected.status} AND VERSION_NO=#{expected.versionNo}

UPDATE CONTRACT_SEMANTIC_UNIT SET PURPOSE=#{row.purpose},ATTEMPT_ID=#{row.attemptId},STATUS=#{row.status},OWNER=#{row.owner},FENCE=#{row.fence},LEASE_UNTIL=#{row.leaseUntil},RESERVED_MS=#{row.reservedMs},DURATION_MS=#{row.durationMs},RESULT_JSON=#{row.resultJson,jdbcType=CLOB},RESULT_SHA256=#{row.resultSha256},SAFE_REASON=#{row.safeReason},CALL_AUDIT_ID=#{row.callAuditId},PROVIDER=#{row.provider},MODEL_NAME=#{row.modelName},REQUEST_FINGERPRINT=#{row.requestFingerprint},CALL_ORDINAL=#{row.callOrdinal},VERSION_NO=#{row.versionNo},UPDATED_AT=#{row.updatedAt} WHERE UNIT_EXECUTION_ID=#{expected.unitExecutionId} AND PLAN_ID=#{expected.planId} AND LOGICAL_UNIT_KEY=#{expected.logicalUnitKey} AND EXECUTION_NO=#{expected.executionNo} AND OWNER=#{expected.owner} AND FENCE=#{expected.fence} AND STATUS=#{expected.status} AND VERSION_NO=#{expected.versionNo}
